dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.line: I’m not made to fit the world — I’m made to rule my own. 👑🐉
dragon.desc: 🐉🔥 You carry a fearless energy — strong-minded, confident, and fiercely protective. You don’t start fires, but you definitely know how to finish them. 😈⚡ You’re loyal to your people, ruthless with disrespect, and never afraid to stand alone. 🖤

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.line: You don’t burn out — you rise from the ashes. ❤️‍🔥
phoenix.desc: 🔥 You’re the one who always comes back stronger. You’re ambitious, resilient, and impossible to keep down for long. ✨ You may go through your own storms, but somehow you always turn them into a comeback. 🪂❤️‍🔥 You don’t just survive — you reinvent yourself and rise again. 🌅

siren.name: Siren
siren.line: You don’t chase attention — you make it follow you. 🧜‍♀️✨
siren.desc: 🧜‍♀️ You’re impossible to ignore. You have a magnetic presence, a sharp mind, and a way of pulling people in without even trying. ✨🌊 You know exactly how to get what you want — and you’re not afraid to use your charm. 😏💙 You’re mysterious, confident, and just a little dangerous when underestimated.

dracula.name: Dracula
dracula.line: Too powerful to be ordinary, too mysterious to be understood. 🩸
dracula.desc: 🦇 You have that “don’t mess with me” energy. You’re bold, magnetic, fiercely independent, and just mysterious enough to keep everyone guessing. You don’t need to be the loudest in the room — you somehow become the one everyone notices. 🖤

witch.name: Witch
witch.line: Peace is my power, and disturbing it is your warning. 🕯️🔮
witch.desc: 🔮 You crave silence, peace, and your own little world. 🌙 You can be ruthless with anyone who disturbs your peace, but fiercely protective and soft with your own people. 🖤 Cold to strangers, loyal to your circle, and absolutely unapologetic about cutting off anyone who interrupts your calm. ✨

ghost.name: Spooky Ghost
ghost.line: A little creepy, a little chaotic, and impossible to explain. 👻🌙
ghost.desc: 👻 You’re the spooky one with chaotic energy. You love creepy things, random surprises, and making people jump just for fun. 😭🖤 You’re mysterious, playful, and definitely not as innocent as you look. 👀🌙 You’re the kind of thing people know exists… they just don’t want to believe it. 🕸️✨

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.line: Too hot to blend in, too wild to be tamed. 🐺
werewolf.desc: 🐺 You’re wild, loyal, and always running a little hotter than everyone else. Your energy is intense, your temper is quick, and your instincts are impossible to ignore. You protect your people fiercely, live by your own rules, and somehow always feel 10°C hotter than the environment. 🌙 You’re fiercely independent and hate being told what to do. 😤 You feel things deeply, love hard, and once someone earns your trust, you’ll have their back no matter what. 🐾🔥

elf.name: Elf
elf.line: Too magical for the ordinary world. ✨
elf.desc: 🌿 You notice the tiny things everyone else misses. You’re calm, curious, slightly mysterious — and somehow always giving main-character-in-an-enchanted-forest energy ✨

dodo.name: Dodo Bird
dodo.line: Life is too short to stress — let’s see what happens ✨🪶
dodo.desc: 🦔 You’re the silly one who makes everything more fun. You’re always in chill mode, turning random moments into unforgettable memories. You don’t take life too seriously — you just go with the flow and live by “Why stress when we can just see what happens?” 😭

questions.q: You walk into a party where you know nobody. What happens?

a.t: Find the quietest corner and stay there
Somehow end up as the main character
Find the strangest person and become friends

questions.q: It is midnight. What are you actually doing?

a.t: Reading something you should have finished weeks ago

questions.q: Someone wrongs a person you care about.

a.t: You cut them off and never explain
You are hurt more than angry

questions.q: How do people describe you when you are not there?

a.t: Kind, but do not push it

questions.q: Pick a place you would rather be.

a.t: Deep water, no bottom in sight

questions.q: Your phone rings. Unknown number.

a.t: Ignore. They will text if it matters

questions.q: What do you do when things go badly wrong?

a.t: Disappear for a while, then come back different
Sit with it. Understand it first

questions.q: Choose the compliment that would actually land.

a.t: You are the most interesting person here
I always feel safe around you
You are terrifying and I mean that well
You have survived a lot and it shows in a good way

questions.q: Your phone dies in the middle of the day.

a.t: You find a charger in four minutes flat
Perfect excuse to disappear for a bit
You borrow a stranger's phone and make a new friend

questions.q: A group project. Who are you?

a.t: The one quietly doing all the work
The one giving everyone their jobs
The one who saves it at the last minute
The one who brought snacks and good vibes

questions.q: Pick a place to spend a free afternoon.

a.t: A rooftop with a view of the whole city
By the sea, as long as possible
A forest trail with no signal

questions.q: Someone says “we need to talk”.

a.t: Already planning three replies in your head
Overthink for an hour, then it was nothing

questions.q: Your ideal weekend plan is…

a.t: A long list, and you finish all of it
A late night with your favourite people

questions.q: What do people notice about you first?

a.t: Your eyes. They say a lot

questions.q: Pick a superpower.

a.t: Read every mind in the room

questions.q: The lights go off during a storm.

a.t: Finally, the good kind of dark
You light candles and feel like a main character
You go outside to watch the lightning

questions.q: How do you reply to messages?

a.t: Three days later, with a perfect reply
Voice note, straight to the point
You read it, reply in your head, forget to send

questions.q: You fail at something important.

a.t: Cry for a day, then come back twice as strong
Nobody will ever know it bothered you

questions.q: Choose a colour for your room.
A friend is late again.

a.t: You leave. Time is not free
You are late too, so it works out
You made new friends while waiting

questions.q: What is your secret talent?
You get to name a pet. You choose…
Your friends call you when…

a.t: They need someone to fix everything
They need the truth, not comfort

questions.q: Pick a time of day.

a.t: 3 am, when the world is quiet

questions.q: Someone copies your style.

a.t: You change your whole style the next day
You notice. You say nothing. You remember

questions.q: What scares you most?

a.t: Nothing. You are the scary one

questions.q: You win a lot of money tomorrow.

a.t: Buy a quiet house far from everyone

questions.q: Pick a movie for tonight.

a.t: An action film with a big comeback
An old comedy you have seen ten times
A fantasy world you can get lost in

questions.q: How do you handle an argument?

a.t: Walk away. Not worth your energy
Get loud, then hug it out
Stay calm until they confuse themselves

questions.q: Your dream job is…

a.t: Anything, as long as it is fun

questions.q: Choose a drink.
You hear a strange noise at night.

a.t: Pretend you did not hear it
You are probably the strange noise
Turn on every light and take charge

questions.q: What would your diary be called?
You walk past a mirror.

a.t: You check it every time. You look great
You make a funny face at yourself
Sometimes it feels like it is watching you

questions.q: Which compliment means the most?
A new person joins your group.

a.t: You decide in five seconds if you like them
You make them feel welcome straight away
You watch them closely for a while
They will be your best friend by tonight

questions.q: Pick a season.
Your bag is full of…

a.t: Just a phone and keys. Minimal

questions.q: How do you take a photo?

a.t: Of the sky, never of yourself
You are always the one taking them
You do not. Live the moment
